title: 2014 AMC 10A 5
statement: On an algebra quiz, \(10\%\) of the students scored \(70\) points, \(35\%\) scored \(80\) points, \(30\%\) scored \(90\) points, and the rest scored \(100\) points. What is the difference between the mean and the median of the students’ scores on this quiz?

solutions.text:
The median is \(90\), because \(45\%\) of the students scored below \(90\) and \(25\%\) scored above \(90\).

The mean is \(0.10\cdot70\) \(+0.35\cdot80\) \(+0.30\cdot90\) \(+0.25\cdot100=87\).

The difference is \(90-87=3\).

Thus, C is the correct answer.
